text: 0.12.0 raised plan-log-unparseable and plan-log-counts-missing from Major to Blocker and gave as its reason that unproven has to block or breaking a bullet is the way past the gate. The premise is false: fails_gate is rank() <= Major, so Major already failed the gate and the bump changed the label and the sort order, not the exit code. The severity stands on what it labels — a finding that disables a blocking check reads as Blocker, which is what plan-log-criteria-unreadable already is — and not on closing a bypass that was never open. Withdrawing it would be the same design litigated in a second release
source: codex review of v0.12.0 / traced fails_gate
